plan: A flamboyant marksman who deals huge damage with his axes as long as he keeps catching them.
aSurveiller: His Q (Spinning Axe). Every axe he catches keeps his damage at its peak: get in his way where his axes land.
contrer: Stand where his axes (Q) land so he must choose between catching them and staying safe.
Avoid trading early: he deals a huge amount of damage early on.
Engage him with several allies: he has few ways to escape.
forces: Earns a lot of gold when he gets kills.
Slows and knocks aside with his E.
faiblesses: Immobile apart from his speed boost (W).
Loses a lot of gold when he dies.

sorts.P: Earns bonus gold by catching axes and getting kills.
sorts.Q: Empowered axe that bounces; he must catch it.
sorts.E: Throws his axes, knocking aside and slowing.
sorts.R: Two axes that cross the map and come back.

momentFort: Very dangerous from the start of the game, especially at level 6 when he can go all in. His biggest advantage is early on, in his lane.
